name: native-tlc-gate
cmd: set -euo pipefail; python3 -m unittest discover -s research/protocols/ic3syn -p test_tlc_native.py -v > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/tests.log" 2>&1; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; python3 research/protocols/ic3syn/tlc_native.py --only consensus --ms 120000 > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/worker.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'feat(research): add native TLC cross-check worker' > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commit-message.txt" > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/commitlint.log" 2>&1
